blocks.text: PORT-AU-PRINCE, Haiti—Haitian electoral authorities has indefinitely postponed the initial stages of presidential and legislative elections due to be held on December 13, according to a statement seen by AFP on Tuesday. “The period originally scheduled for the electoral campaign has been postponed,” the Provisional Electoral Council’s statement said. It omitted any mention of the election date and added that the electoral timetable “will be made public as soon as possible.” Haiti has not held elections since 2016, and its last president, assassinated in 2021, has not been replaced. /apl...
